scope: Read full runner, guard generator and coverage source generator; statically parsed all249 frozen guards and rehashed source/audit/guard payloads. No generator, guard, runner, compiler or version query invoked.
observations: Every cut proposition refers directly to the pinned actual decoder subtree and exact SitePrefix246 checker. Every binary join consumes both children, and the final three typed clients cover all_sites plus arbitrary checked and total program walks.
